contract.targets: Only registered scalar duration_s/distance_m goals; equality is required, not a minimum. Unregistered min/max keys do not create a new contract.
contract.mode_policy: Frozen original plan and actual row must both declare the matching mode. Missing, unknown or incompatible original mode is unknown; never infer it from the target key or live catalog.
contract.preserved: Original plan identity and values, group completion denominator, load/reps/RIR behavior, missing vs zero.
contract.scope: One confirmed STR09 omission. No additional discovery; 77 matrix entries were read but not exhaustively revalidated.
contract.tests: Original 28 plus eight post-review mode/range boundary cases; initial pre-fix run covers only original 28.
